t.zh: <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref>里，寄存卡存的是线上来的位。存进去的也可以是板上算出的任何值，下一拍再拿来接着算。
t.en: In <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref> the register kept the bit off the wire. It can keep anything the board works out, to be worked on again the next tick.

brief.zh: 线上出现 1 之前一直说 0；出现过 1 以后，每一拍都说 1。
brief.en: Say 0 until a 1 has come down the wire, and 1 on every tick after that.

hint.zh: 要记住的是「到现在为止听到过 1 没有」。
hint.en: What has to be remembered is whether a 1 has been heard yet.

hint.zh: 这一拍该说什么，取决于这一拍听到的和上一拍记下的。
hint.en: What to say this tick depends on what is heard now and what was kept last tick.

hint.zh: 听到 1 的那一拍就要说 1，不能等到下一拍。
hint.en: On the very tick a 1 is heard, the board must already say 1, not a tick later.
